Original v1.1 → supplied v1.2 patch

PNG files embedded byte-identically. Checkerboard is HTML background only. Runtime uses individual push frames. Sheet first cell contains the original idle alpha; other cells match the five push frames. Hidden RGB artifacts at alpha zero are not visible defects.
